exitCode.description: Only when the runner reports one or the output says "Exit code N".

oneOf.description: The command's first line, `cd x &&` stripped.

receipts.description: Counted from the thread's items when it ended.

statusReason.description: Queued, parked or failed: why, e.g. "slots: 40/40 in use", "usage limit: resumes 14:05".

envName.description: secret with an env: sink: the variable it writes, when not the one its key names (`secretEnvName`).

evidence.description: What closed or reopened it: "fingerprint ab12cd34", a gated run's exit code and output tail, a failed verify.

gated.description: Required for approve; immutable once the ask exists.

number.description: Fixed within its batch; never renumbered.

permission.description: approve: the session prompt it answers, instead of `gated`.

proceededOnRec.description: The lead carried on with the recommendation; the answer confirms or overrides it.

projectRef.description: Absent only on an `intake.route.*` ask: the human picks the project by answering it.

verify.description: do: the check the hub runs once the human ticks it done; a failure reopens the ask with the evidence.

asks.description: The asks in those batches, by batch then number.

dataB64.description: Standard base64; at most 5 MiB decoded.

Attention.description:

quiet hours; "urgent": notify even during quiet hours (money and irreversible). Absent: the inbox and the digest
are enough.

coalesceSec.description: At most one notification per this many seconds; what arrives meanwhile is folded into the next.

quiet.description: Only "urgent" events notify inside these; empty when quiet hours are off. Ask again after the last one ends.

baseline.description: Research: what the candidate is compared against, and how both are measured.

decisionRule.description: Research: frozen with the brief, so the verdict can't move the goalposts.

doneWhen.description: At least one; frozen with the brief.

oneOf.description: Waiting on the machine or the provider: retries, startup, compaction, claude-local time.

lastError.description: The refusal fix, conflicting paths, or failing check names.

mergedSha.description: The squash commit on the base; set on merge.

A webhook subscription has been failing for over an hour.

Every done-when check passed. `data.workstreamId`.
`data.taskId`, `data.prHeadSha`, `data.blocking`.
`data.incidentId`, `data.class`.

train merged on fleetd's own checks.
`data.repo`, `data.reason`.
`data.repo`.

Something that is not the train's sits where its worktree goes, and a person has to move it; `data.changeId`,

Refused at enqueue; `data.prUrl`, `data.fix`.
Where an intent went; `data.workstreamId` or `data.askId`, `data.template`, `data.reason`, `data.playbook`.
A research workstream's computed verdict; `data.workstreamId`, `data.outcome`, `data.metricValues`.
M4: a machine's login hit the same limit on several threads, or its proxy has no account; dispatch there pauses.

200 characters).

taskIds.description: Join to the live feed's lanes for what each agent is doing now.

number.description: The batch item number; absent for "pref:" and "forget".

source.description: The written decision's source and by, filled by the hub from the caller (human device or agent key).

evidence.description: Plain-language lines: claim ids with their failing checks, ratios, SHAs.

asked about a key that already had an active Decision; `override`, a human replaced a lead's Decision with another
value; `playbook_reverted`, a retro wording change missed its metric and was rolled back.

numbers.description: The numbers the message was built from (durations in ms).

spanIds.description: At most 200; `time_spans { rule }` lists them all.

echo.description: Absent: the router could not place it (intake_submit would ask the human).

the lead's wake as a "References:" block.

oneOf.description: Repo-relative.

projectRef.description: The texts in effect for this project; absent: hub-wide.

Receipts.description: Counted by the hub from the task's thread items, never from its prose.

n.description: Runs in a row with no edit between them.

ResearchOutcome.description: STOP is a success: the question was answered.

ResearchVerdict.description: Computed by the hub, never reported by an agent; `outcome` always follows from `rule` and `metricValues`.

windowDays.description: Measured over this many days after the change, against the same span before it.

RetroMetricClass.description:
The fixed metric list, defined in code: incident counts per class, and agent-minutes per done workstream. A
proposal names one; the retro cannot add or change them.

baseline.description: The window before it applied; `measured` is the window after.

claimedKind.description: What the model said it was.

dueAt.description: When a wording change's window ends and its metric is computed.

fields.description: Frontmatter fields the diff changes, plus "body".

kind.description: Decided by the hub from the fields the diff touches.

ref.description: The version it applied and the one it replaced.

run.description: The retro run that proposed it.

RetroProposalState.description:
suggested: advise-only, nothing applies. pending: a gate change waiting for the weekly Ask; asked: in it.
measuring: a wording change applied, its window running; then kept or reverted. applied: a gate change a person
approved. rejected: a person said no. stale: the playbook changed under it, so its diff no longer applies.

apply.description: The global Decision policy.retro.apply is true: wording changes apply on their own and gate changes are asked.

advise.description: Nothing it proposed applies: `--advise`, or `policy.retro.apply` is not true.

incidents.description: Incidents in the window it was given.

usage.description: Absent when there was nothing to look at and no turn ran.

RetroRunDropped.description: A change the hub refused, with why.

advise.description: Propose only, even when policy.retro.apply is true.

RetroSnapshot.description:
A metric's values over one window; agent-minutes is null when no workstream finished in it. Its keys are
snake_case on the wire.

oneOf.description: A steer was not acknowledged, or has gone 10 minutes delivered without it.

SafetyRule.description: A rule the default text carries, found in a text by `needle` (a case-insensitive regex).

present.description: In `PromptDetail`: whether the effective text still matches `needle`.

ScopePart.description: A child figure: the fleet's projects, a project's milestones, an order's milestones.

scope.description: Open it as its own scope (projects and orders).

SecretFingerprint.description: 8 lowercase hex characters: the sha256 prefix of the plaintext

sealed.description: Sealed in the desktop app to the sink machine's `box_pub_key` (see Machine).

SessionPrompt.description: `session_prompt_get`: exactly what a session was told at its start.

disallowedTools.description: Tools the claude runner never offers a fleetd session.

textSha.description: The text's full git blob SHA.

SessionPromptRef.description: One prompt a session pinned at its start; every later message to it renders from this text.

Since.description: Counts since the reading key last looked at this scope. Zero counts are hidden by clients.

pruned.description: The mark is older than the event log keeps ("since more than 30 days").

scopeItems.description: Net items added (negative: dropped) by scope changes.

seenAt.description: Absent: never looked (or not a human key).

SleptAt.description: A sleep a machine's node reported on waking, epoch milliseconds (the same fields as `machine.slept`).

SleptSpan.description: A span a machine spent asleep, epoch milliseconds; `machine.slept` carries the same fields as its data.

reservedBand.description: Slots of the cap only lead turns may take.

Span.description: A stored span, as the tools return it.

exclMs.description: Exclusive time: the part no child covers. Absent while open and on envelopes.

itemId.description: The item id in the thread (claude's tool_use or message id), for `thread_window`.

SpanExtra.description: Small per-kind facts. Every field is optional and bounded.

answeredBy.description: Who answered, e.g. a key's label. Never a secret.

check.description: `ci.check`: the check name and its page.

claudeMs.description: `tool.*`: claude's own figure for the call, when the result carries one.

httpStatus.description: `wait.retry.api`: the HTTP status claude retried on.

nodeStartMs.description: The node's own start stamp, kept when the clock offset was above 100 ms.

peakQueued.description: `slots.full`: the peak count of tasks queued for a slot, and the cap.

reason.description: Free text from the source, e.g. a queue reason or a stop reason.

requestId.description: `wait.permission`: the node's request id, joined to the hub ask.

statedDelayMs.description: `wait.retry.*`: the delay claude or the node announced. The span is the real wait.

tool.description: The tool's name, for tool and permission spans.

SpanKind.description:
What a span measures. Each kind belongs to exactly one [`Category`]. The code is the stored integer and
never changes; new kinds take new codes.

oneOf.description: A run's envelope, lifecycle started to its end. Its leaves tile it; it has no exclusive time of its own.
One assistant message, from the previous visible stream event to `message_stop`.
Previous visible stream event to `message_start`: claude-local work, network, API queueing and prefill.
Read, Grep, Glob, LS.
Edit, MultiEdit, Write, NotebookEdit.
Overlapping tool calls from one message; the calls are its children.
Train git, and agent Bash whose program is `git` or `gh`.
Time inside a run that no other span covers: claude-local work between stream events.
A write waiting in the hub's queue for an offline machine.
A send waiting behind the session's active run.
The fleet's slots were all held. On the fleet lane.
A permission prompt, inside its tool span; `extra.decidedBy` says who answered.
A blocking ask, published to answered.
An ask filed to its batch being published.
An ask that blocked nothing. On the asks lane only, never on a critical path.
Waiting in the train's line.
One check run, GitHub's own `started_at` to `completed_at`.
The train's push to the check's start.
needs_rebase or ci_failed until the next head.
The intake router, from submit to routed.
Lost data: spans the node dropped or the hub could not take. `extra.count` says how many.
Still open when it was cut, e.g. a check still running when a red one decided.

Spark.description:
Work per 2 s bucket, oldest first, ending with the bucket that ends at `end_at`. A sample is
`min(255, 16 × items started + streamed chars / 32 + output tokens not streamed as text / 8)`; a bucket with
no frames is 0.

StaleMark.description: Why a part is not live: its source went quiet past its cadence.

reason.description: "no heartbeat from forge for 4m", "GitHub not reached for 4m: …".

since.description: The source's last good signal (a heartbeat, a GitHub answer, a train pass).

StalePrompt.description:
An override edited from an older default than the one this release ships. It stays in effect until the human
saves it again with `base` = `current.ref`, or resets it.

base.description: The default it was edited from; absent when the file has no `base` or that text is unknown to this hub.

merged.description: A line 3-way merge of base → current into yours; with `<<<<<<<` markers where they conflict.

StaleSource.description:
A source that is stale now, `since` its last good signal. `source` is `machine:<m>`, `usage:<m>`, `ci:<repo>`,
`github:<repo>`, `train:<repo>` or
`webhook:<repo>`.

now.description: The hub clock when the doc was rendered.

seq.description: The event log's head the doc reflects; `status_seen` records it.

title.description: "Fleet", the project's title or the order's.

version.description: Bumps whenever the doc's content changes; `status_wait` waits past it.

virtualTier.description: The order's tier when the scope is an order with no plan items.

StatusEta.description: ETA from measured throughput; the lead's own estimate only as a comparison.

chain.description: The serial chain that sets `current` when it is later than throughput says, e.g. "P12 full lab run".

lead.description: The lead's calibrated estimate, present when it differs from `current` by more than max(1 h, 50%).

original.description: The first ETA with enough samples, stored once (orders and milestones only).

samples.description: Items verified in the 7-day window behind `rate`.

sinceSeq.description: Count "since" from this seq instead of the key's status_seen mark (a client that keeps its own mark).

StatusScope.description: What a status doc covers. `key()` is the form stored per human key ("fleet", "project:forge/p1", "order:W41").

recorded.description: False for agent keys: only a person's look moves the mark.

StatusSteer.description: A steer as the status doc shows it: "↳ you steered S12 14:02 · acknowledged · −1 item".

planChange.description: The plan change it made, e.g. "−1 item".

after.description: The version the caller has; absent waits for none (answers at once).

ackExcerpt.description: Acknowledged: the reply naming it; unacknowledged: the first reply. First 200 characters.

detail.description:
Plain words on the stage: "waiting for lab-b (until 14:30)", "held: usage resets 14:00", the failure, or
"sent (node older than 0.9)" when the node cannot report receipts.

planChange.description: A plan change the steer made, e.g. "−1 item".

runId.description: The node run id it was sent as; also the user message id in the thread.

seenAt.description: The first model request that carried it.

stoppedTool.description: `how = stopped`: one line on the step it stopped.

workstreamId.description: The order it belongs to (a task's own order for a task steer).

SteerMode.description: How a steer reaches a running agent.

oneOf.description:
Enter, "add to the lead's queue": taken in at the agent's next tool boundary, as its own turn. Never cuts a
running tool.
⌘Enter, "interrupt and redirect now": stops the current step and delivers at once.

ackExcerpt.description: Acknowledged: the reply naming it; unacknowledged: the first reply. First 200 characters.

detail.description:
Plain words on the stage: "waiting for lab-b (until 14:30)", "held: usage resets 14:00", the failure, or
"sent (node older than 0.9)" when the node cannot report receipts.

planChange.description: A plan change the steer made, e.g. "−1 item".

runId.description: The node run id it was sent as; also the user message id in the thread.

seenAt.description: The first model request that carried it.

stoppedTool.description: `how = stopped`: one line on the step it stopped.

workstreamId.description: The order it belongs to (a task's own order for a task steer).

oneOf.description: The hub stored it, or put it in the offline queue.
claude's context took it in (`command_lifecycle started`).
The agent's reply named its id, or a lead call did (`--steer S12`).
Its run ended with no reply naming it.
Dropped while still queued.
The machine stayed offline past the queue's TTL.

SteerTarget.description: Who a steer is for: an order's lead, or one task (writer, reviewer, verifier, …).

ackExcerpt.description: Acknowledged: the reply naming it; unacknowledged: the first reply. First 200 characters.

detail.description:
Plain words on the stage: "waiting for lab-b (until 14:30)", "held: usage resets 14:00", the failure, or
"sent (node older than 0.9)" when the node cannot report receipts.

planChange.description: A plan change the steer made, e.g. "−1 item".

runId.description: The node run id it was sent as; also the user message id in the thread.

seenAt.description: The first model request that carried it.

stoppedTool.description: `how = stopped`: one line on the step it stopped.

workstreamId.description: The order it belongs to (a task's own order for a task steer).

afterN.description: Only steers after this number (the n of `S<n>`).

expect.description: What the human should see when the step worked.

Subscription.description: A webhook push target. Its signing secret is shown once by subscription_set and never returned again.

createdBy.description: keyId of the agent key that created it.

failingSince.description: When deliveries started failing; absent while healthy.

secret.description: The webhook signing secret. Shown only here; store it now.

itemId.description: The plan item it was spawned for (`--item`).

parked.description: M4: its thread hit a usage limit; the task is idle until fleetd sends "continue" at `resumeAt`.

pr.description: The PR a review task reviews. Required at spawn for review; absent on hub-spawned judge tasks and older rows.

queuedReason.description: Why it is queued, e.g. "lease: docs held by T1" or "slots: 40/40 in use".

serves.description: Required at spawn for write tasks; optional here for tasks stored before M6.

TaskCounts.description: A project's tasks by state, all time.

TaskKind.description: Only write tasks get a worktree and leases.

claimsUnverified.description: The tail claims success ("tests pass", "fixed", ...) while `receipts.commands` is 0. Absent before M6.

receipts.description: Absent on results stored before M6.

tail.description: The latest assistant message, trimmed to its last 2000 characters.

message.description: Deny only: what claude is told instead of running the tool.

requestId.description: The prompt answered, from the thread.waiting event; absent means the one open now.

askId.description: The tool_permission ask this answer closed, if one was open.

queued.description: True when the machine is offline and the message waits in the hub's queue.

queuedUntil.description: When a queued message expires undelivered.

effort.description: As reported by the runner; not narrowed to Effort because it may report other levels.

headline.description: First line of the latest visible assistant text.

focus.description: The index of `itemId` in `items`; absent when the node no longer has it.

storedBytes.description: The hub's span tables on disk.

oneOf.description: The project's lead sessions, split across orders by the workstreams each wake served.
Includes the task's subagents (tasks it spawned).

nextAfterId.description: Absent when there are no more.

Tokens.description: Summed over the lane's runs. `live`: the running run's usage is streaming in (else it updates at each run's end).

ToolPermission.description:
An approve ask raised by a session's tool permission prompt (`tool_permission`) instead of a gated command: answering
it answers the prompt on the project's node. Its machine is the ask's project's.

summary.description: The command, the path, or the tool's own description.

TrainLive.description: One repo's merge train, resolved for the strip: head first, then the queue in order, then today's merges.

head.description: The Change being rebased, checked or merged now.

UsageBreaker.description: Open: no new turns start on the machine's login until `until` or usage_resume.

message.description: The plain notice, as the usage.breaker event said it.

until.description: Absent while open means until usage_resume.

UsageClass.description:
What stopped a turn. `usage_limit`: the plan's usage limit or a proxy cooldown, with a reset. `rate_limit`: a 429.
`pool_exhausted`: the user's proxy has no account for the model; it waits for usage_resume.

UsageParked.description: A task or lead whose thread hit a limit; fleetd sends it one "continue" at `resume_at`.

resumeAt.description: Absent for pool_exhausted: it resumes on usage_resume.

lastEvents.description: The latest thread.usage_limited, usage.breaker and usage.resumed events for the machine, oldest first.

catchUp.description: What to do with a firing missed while the hub was down.

createdBy.description: keyId of the agent key that set it.

nextRunAt.description: Absent once the wake is done or cancelled.

WakeCron.description: Standard 5-field cron; the hub parses it.

oneOf.description: Counts toward the headline number.
Shown beside the number, never in it.

estimateActual.description: Hub-filled, outside the frozen brief. Set when it starts running with a raw estimate.

outcome.description: Research workstreams, once the verdict is computed; set together with `verdict`. A STOP is done, not failed.

parent.description: M9 finish-all: the finish-all workstream that spawned this one, and the value source it was spawned for.

playbook.description: Pinned at creation; the brief freeze validates against this version. Absent on workstreams from before M9.

actualMinutes.description: Wall-clock minutes from running to done; set on done.

ratioAtStart.description: The tier's calibration ratio when it started running.

eta.description: Absent without a raw estimate in the brief.

by.description: Who submitted it: an agent keyId, "human" or "lead:<machineId>/<projectId>".

parent.description: The project's open finish-all workstream it is a child of.
